figures.before: What TPO Is and How It Performs in Florida
figures.alt: Commercial low-slope roof membrane at a primary and emergency scupper with clean flashing transitions and drainage slope
figures.caption: A commercial roof membrane has to work with the drains, scuppers, parapets, penetrations, transitions, and drainage plan around it. The field membrane is only one part of the assembly.

figures.before: What EPDM Is and How It Performs in Florida
figures.alt: Commercial low-slope roof with organized drainage layout, scuppers, tapered insulation transitions, and parapet edges
figures.caption: System selection should account for the building layout and water path. Slope, drains, overflow, penetrations, access, service conditions, and edge details shape performance over time.

figures.alt: Commercial roof scupper drainage detail with membrane flashing, metal edge, and clear water path through the parapet
figures.caption: Installed cost is influenced by the roof condition, insulation, slope correction, flashing, penetrations, drains, edge metal, removal needs, access, and warranty requirements as well as the membrane itself.
